items.title: What should the label tell me?
items.body:
A resin label should identify the ingredient and format plainly, then show the serving directions for that specific product.

Do not borrow a capsule study's amount for a resin jar. Different preparations are not interchangeable.
items.alt: A stainless spoon, dark resin-like abstract smear and blank notebook on linen
items.evidence_label: Buyer check · read the product label

items.title: Did studies test this resin?
items.body:
Human studies tested specified shilajit preparations, not every resin sold online. The preparation and population belong beside every result.

That distinction matters: a study can inform a category question without proving this exact jar matches its material.

chart.title: What the human studies actually tested
chart.source: Pandit et al., Andrologia 2016. Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of a specified purified preparation.

items.evidence_label: Human evidence · Pandit et al., Andrologia 2016

items.title: What did one trial measure?
items.body:
A randomized trial in healthy men measured testosterone outcomes after repeated use of a specified purified shilajit preparation.

The result belongs to that preparation and outcome. It did not test this resin, general energy, or every first-time buyer.

chart.title: One study, one defined question
chart.source: Pandit et al., Andrologia 2016. Healthy men aged 45 to 55; specified purified preparation; testosterone outcomes.

items.evidence_label: Human RCT · Pandit et al., Andrologia 2016

items.title: Was strength tested too?
items.body:
Another randomized trial studied recreationally active men during an eight-week protocol involving fatigue and muscular-strength outcomes.

Its preparation, dose, and participants were specific. The study did not test this resin or prove a universal performance effect.
items.evidence: Human RCT, Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition 2019

chart.title: Study scope, not a product promise
chart.source: Keller et al., JISSN 2019. Randomized trial in 63 men; eight-week protocol; specified preparation.

items.evidence_label: Human RCT · Keller et al., JISSN 2019

items.title: Can one ingredient prove all?
items.body:
No. A small human study explored skin-related biological signals after a defined shilajit preparation, not every outcome shoppers associate with the ingredient.

Keep each claim tied to the population, preparation, and measurement. A narrow result should stay narrow.
items.evidence: Human study, skin transcriptome and microvascular mechanisms
items.alt: Neutral botanical materials and blank ingredient cards arranged on linen
items.evidence_label: Human study · Das et al., Journal of Medicinal Food 2019

items.title: What does safety research say?
items.body:
A 2025 laboratory survey reported thallium in some raw shilajit and finished supplements. It is a reason to ask about testing, not proof every jar is contaminated.

The survey did not establish a safe serving for this resin. Its findings do not substitute for lot-specific documentation.
items.alt: A blank laboratory-style report, magnifying glass and neutral sample vial on a clean desk
items.evidence_label: Laboratory survey · Kamgar et al., BMC Chemistry 2025

items.title: How do I choose a routine?
items.body:
Resin adds a preparation step: portion it, mix it, and clean the spoon or cup. That friction can matter more than a dramatic promise.

Choose the format whose instructions fit your morning. Consistency is practical, not proof of an effect.
items.evidence: Practical format comparison, no clinical claim
items.alt: Warm drink, stainless spoon, blank notebook and linen towel in a calm morning setup
items.evidence_label: Buyer checklist · match the format to your routine

bridge.title: Convenience is part of consistency
bridge.body:
Daily use only works when preparation fits the habit. For a resin routine, that means a repeatable portion and a drink you will actually prepare.

ShilaSource Himalayan Shilajit Resin is one resin-format option. Its label identifies ShilaSource, Himalayan Shilajit Resin, Dietary Supplement, and the other printed pack lines.

Taking medication or managing a health condition? Check with a qualified healthcare professional first.
